question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Tranquil
solution:
The correct answer is "**Calm**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Tranquil**: free from disturbance;
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given options.
 
 
• **Aware: **having knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.
 
• **Dazed: **unable to think or react properly; bewildered.
 
• **Calm: **not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions.
 
• **Alert: **quick to notice any unusual and potentially dangerous or difficult circumstances; vigilant.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**calm**" is the synonym of "tranquil"
 
 
• **Example**: *He was very **calm **__before the job interview.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Tranquil**: अशांति से मुक्त
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given options.
 
 
• **Aware:**** **किसी स्थिति या तथ्य का ज्ञान या धारणा होना।
 
• **Dazed:**** **ठीक से सोचने या प्रतिक्रिया करने में असमर्थ; हतप्रभ।
 
• **Calm:**** **घबराहट, क्रोध, या अन्य मजबूत भावनाओं को दिखाना या महसूस नहीं करना।
 
• **Alert:**** **किसी भी असामान्य और संभावित खतरनाक या कठिन परिस्थितियों को तुरंत नोटिस करना; चौकस।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**calm**" is the synonym of "tranquil".
